clips.title: The story
paras: Arcane Feedback is a priest quest given by High Priest Rohan in Ironforge to human acolytes visiting Khaz Modan. Rohan directs the developing priest home to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind to receive teachings tailored specifically to the traditions of humankind. It marks a key moment of progression where young disciples begin mastering racial manifestations of their faith.

When a human priest seeks advanced spiritual tutelage in the halls of the Mystic Ward, High Priest Rohan greets them with reverence but sets a boundary. While dwarven and human priests share devotion to the Holy Light, each civilization nurtures its own particular rites, disciplines, and defensive prayers. Rather than imparting Ironforge's unique secrets, Rohan sends human clergy back to their cultural roots in Elwynn, ensuring they master their people's distinct heritage.

Upon returning to Stormwind City, the acolyte reports to High Priestess Laurena within the grand Cathedral of Light. Laurena is relieved to see Rohan's guidance reach the traveler, welcoming them back just as their nascent powers begin to flourish. This return paves the way for deeper initiation into the Kingdom of Stormwind's spiritual practices, preparing practitioners to wield the Holy Light against the rising threats encircling the realm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As much as I'd like to show you our own special teachings of the Light, it is not our place. Your place is back in Stormwind with your own kind, friend... For now. Believe me, I mean no offense. When you return to High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light you'll understand what I'm talking about--the time has come for your race to prepare you for the future; to separate yourself from others that follow a similar path.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you have wonderful timing, friend. I was beginning to wonder if all of my messengers had been successful. I'm glad to see they were, otherwise I would wager you'd still be out in the world learning more about all the threats that exist against our people.
Are you ready? Ready for more training I mean. You're growing in power more quickly, and I feel you are ready to learn more about our faith.
